::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Mainland China's third-largest foundry by revenue after SMIC and Hua Hong — a Taiwan (Powerchip)-mainland joint venture, a structure now rare given cross-strait tensions.
:::

**Chinese name:** 晶合集成 (Jīnghé Jíchéng)

## What does this facility make?

Display driver ICs (DDIC) and CMOS image sensors (CIS) on 12-inch wafers — a foundry niche distinct from SMIC/Hua Hong's broader logic focus.

## Why does it matter?

Shows Taiwanese foundry know-how transferring into a mainland-listed, mainland-controlled entity through a JV structure, ahead of any Taiwan-specific tracker this project might build later.
